calls.reason: The 2023 agreement restricts compulsory AI use, and the WGA ratified another agreement in 2026. Neither establishes nor rules out eventual AI-driven union destruction; the packet documents no such causal sequence.

Klarna reported extensive AI use but retained human access. CFPB complaints document barriers to help, but together these sources do not establish a sustained trend linking AI adoption to reduced accountability.

TIME and the bargaining records establish that AI restrictions were disputed. They do not establish the executive motive Zitron attributes, while the AMPTP offered a different explanation and Zitron acknowledged assuming motives.
Intercom describes service-task imitation, and the chatbot study measures empathetic responses. Neither settles felt empathy or personal accountability, leaving the main assertion unclear.
